name: unifi-os-server
description: UniFi OS Server running in Docker with full systemd-based service management. Includes the UniFi Network Application, identity hub, credential server, and all supporting services (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, nginx). Requirements: - Unraid 6.12 or newer (cgroup v2 required) - At least 4 GB RAM (6-8 GB recommended) - Persistent storage configured for all listed paths IMPORTANT - Device Adoption: - Set UOS_SYSTEM_IP to the IP address or hostname of your Docker host. - Without this, UniFi devices cannot be adopted. First Boot: - All services take 3-5 minutes to initialize on first start. - Do not access the GUI until startup is complete. - Monitor progress: Unraid Docker tab -> Container log, or: docker logs -f unifi-os-server GUI Access: https://[your-Unraid-ip]:11443 Note: The GUI uses a self-signed certificate. Accept the browser security warning to proceed. Troubleshooting: docker logs -f unifi-os-server docker exec -it unifi-os-server systemctl list-jobs docker exec -it unifi-os-server ss -tulpn docker exec -it unifi-os-server journalctl -u unifi-core -f docker exec -it unifi-os-server journalctl -u postgresql -f Source: https://github.com/giiibates/unifi-os-server

paths.name: cgroup (systemd)
paths.description: REQUIRED: read-write cgroup mount for systemd as PID 1. Without this the container does not start unless Privileged=true.

paths.name: PostgreSQL Library
paths.description: Path for PostgreSQL data (required for persistent databases)

ports.name: UniFi OS Server GUI
ports.description: UniFi OS Server GUI/API Port (container listens on 443, mapped to host port 11443)

ports.name: Device Communication
ports.description: Device and application communication port (required for adoption)

variables.name: UOS System IP/Hostname
variables.description: REQUIRED: IP address or hostname of your Docker host (e.g. 192.168.1.10). Used for UniFi device adoption and remote management.

variables.name: Hardware Platform
variables.description: Leave empty for standard hardware, or set to 'synology' if running on a Synology NAS.

variables.name: Show systemd journal in Docker logs
variables.description: Forward the full systemd journal to Docker logs. Default false shows only the startup banner and entrypoint summary.
